name: Event
description: A high-energy poster template for conferences, launches, and meetups: uppercase Archivo Black display type, oversized accent dates, a scrolling marquee strip, and the full set — hero, speakers, schedule, tickets.
whenToUse: Pick for getting people to attend something: conferences, meetups, launch events, hackathons, workshops, webinars. The chain covers the attendee journey — poster hero with oversized dates and a scrolling marquee strip, speaker grid, schedule, ticket tiers, sponsor wall, footer. High-energy poster look: uppercase Archivo Black display type, vivid rose accent on light ground. Avoid for evergreen marketing sites, portfolios, or editorial content.
